text: {"summary":"Fashion designer Charlotte Ronson’s New York City home, featured on Domaine Home, combines a comfortable, airy feel with colorful furnishings and eclectic artwork. White walls highlight her art collection, while baby-blue dining chairs and fresh flowers add bright accents to the space."}

{"summary":"CBS canceled “We Are Men” after two low-rated episodes and will bring back “Mike and Molly” on November 4 at 9 p.m. Starting October 14, “2 Broke Girls” moves to 8:30 p.m., with “The Big Bang Theory” repeats filling the 9 p.m. slot until then."}

{"summary":"Ratan Tata said the leadership dispute involving Cyrus Mistry had left him lonely and hurt by what he described as largely unsubstantiated attacks on his and Tata Group’s reputations. Speaking at a Tata Chemicals shareholders’ meeting called to remove Nusli Wadia, he thanked shareholders for their overwhelming support."}

{"summary":"The article curates 29 influential pieces published online in 2016, predominantly by women, spanning politics, racism, sexual violence, reproductive rights, poverty and popular culture. Featuring writers including Roxane Gay, Rebecca Traister and Masha Gessen, it argues that amplifying women’s and marginalized voices is especially important following Donald Trump’s election."}

{"summary":"Marine biologists worry that Finding Dory could boost demand for blue tangs as pets, just as Finding Nemo increased clownfish sales by 40%. Unlike captive-bred clownfish, blue tangs fare poorly in tanks, and increased collection in loosely regulated waters around Indonesia and the Philippines could damage marine ecosystems."}

{"summary":"Around 40 people suffered burns during a firewalking exercise at a Tony Robbins seminar in Dallas attended by more than 7,000 people. Firewalking relies on low heat transfer and brief contact with coals; the article suggests some participants may have lingered to take selfies, increasing their risk of burns."}

{"summary":"Despite preferring the Samsung Galaxy S7’s design, camera and Android software, the author switched to an iPhone 6s Plus because the S7 routinely died around 5 p.m. under heavy use. The iPhone’s longer battery life, attributed to better hardware-software optimization, outweighed its less appealing features."}

{"summary":"The article recommends 12 standout 2016 films for home viewing, spanning Disney adventures, horror, documentaries and dramas, including “The Jungle Book,” “13th,” “Barry” and “Zootopia.” Eleven are Netflix selections—with “Under the Shadow” arriving January 9—while Hulu offers “Whiskey Tango Foxtrot,” starring Tina Fey as a war correspondent."}
{"summary":"The nation’s food industry plans to simplify food labels with clearer language to reduce consumer confusion. The updated labels are expected to appear in grocery stores soon."}

{"summary":"ScHoolboy Q revealed he nearly quit rap after releasing Oxymoron because years away from home had left him little time to raise his seven-year-old daughter. Although he has since released another album, he said he refuses to put his career and money ahead of his family."}

{"summary":"Cinematographer Dean Cundey revealed a subtle visual clue in John Carpenter’s The Thing: a small gleam in characters’ eyes signals they are still human rather than alien imitations. The detail emerged during commentary recorded for a new Blu-ray release, inviting viewers to reconsider the film’s ambiguous ending."}

{"summary":"Spark topped the Commerce Commission’s complaints list with 140 complaints, followed by Vodafone with 133, according to its 2016 Consumer Issues Paper. Pricing was the most common concern, but the commission cautioned that complaints did not necessarily indicate legal breaches and that larger companies were more likely to attract them."}

{"summary":"This lighthearted roundup highlights 19 teens whose antics and unusual experiences stood out in 2016, from elaborate senior photos and a dinosaur-costumed homecoming win to befriending a deer and making tiny pancakes for chickens. Other entries include makeup pranks, prom theatrics, and a grim discovery while playing Pokémon Go."}

{"summary":"Some men are using apps such as iAmAMan and uPMS to track colleagues’ and partners’ menstrual cycles, claiming it helps them avoid PMS-related mood changes. The article describes one workplace case and reports public backlash on Twitter over the practice."}

{"summary":"Amy Cazin launched natural deodorant company Primal Pit Paste with $100, generating over $800,000 in sales in its first 18 months, but declined Wal-Mart’s offer because she couldn’t meet its volume demands. The company later expanded to Whole Foods and thousands of independent retailers while maintaining steady growth."}

{"summary":"While riding near Little Rock, Arkansas, Bret and Zach Winingar rescued an emaciated dog trapped in a crate, named her Charlie Bravo, and ultimately adopted her after getting her veterinary care. Her recovery went viral, prompting donations that covered her treatment and inspired plans for a charity called C.B.’s Angels."}

{"summary":"Well + Good’s Melisse Gelula and Alexia Brue promote bone broth as a filling morning drink, citing purported benefits for bones, skin, digestion and immunity. The article includes a recipe using high-quality bones, vegetables, herbs and apple cider vinegar, simmered for eight to 24 hours and refrigerated for up to four days."}

{"summary":"An Arkansas man’s Roomba spread dog feces throughout his home, illustrating the pitfalls of household automation. The article argues that robot cleaners and smart appliances often deliver limited time savings while requiring supervision, and that unpredictable home environments make meaningful improvements harder than Silicon Valley’s optimism suggests."}

{"summary":"McLaren plans to invest £1 billion ($1.45 billion) in research and development to launch 15 new cars by 2022, including a P1 successor, while increasing annual sales from 2,000 to 5,000. The investment will fund new powertrains and carbon-fiber structures, including hybrid and electric technology, amid tightening fuel regulations."}

{"summary":"Whole Foods co-CEO Walter Robb says he won’t hire candidates who lack humility or excessively promote themselves, while Google similarly values openness to others’ ideas. Experts advise job seekers to balance confidence with humility by acknowledging coworkers’ contributions and showing how they can help others and the organization succeed."}

{"summary":"Amateur archaeologists discovered a previously unmapped passage beneath Emperor Hadrian’s Villa in Tivoli, Italy, connecting its Academy area to a 2.5-mile underground roadway. The estate’s extensive tunnel network likely let slaves, merchants and supply carts move unseen, though the newly uncovered passage’s specific purpose remains uncertain."}

{"summary":"This satirical article invents GTA VI announcements, joking about improved graphics, unreliable online servers, mature content, costly microtransactions and release delays. It mocks gaming industry practices and fan expectations rather than reporting genuine Rockstar news, explicitly identifying itself as fiction."}

{"summary":"The article questions the lasting impact of NBC’s “The Biggest Loser,” which showed contestants losing substantial weight through eight-hour daily training sessions. It suggests those dramatic results were temporary rather than the permanent transformations the show appeared to promise."}

{"summary":"The article says four-blade ceiling fans common in the US run more slowly and circulate air to supplement air conditioning. In India, three-blade fans are typically used independently for cooling; their lighter design allows higher speeds and, according to the article, greater energy efficiency."}

{"summary":"The article recommends 20 smartphone apps to encourage outdoor activity, from walking, cycling and wildlife spotting to stargazing, geocaching and camping. Highlights include ViewRanger for trail maps, Strava for exercise tracking and social connections, and family-friendly tools such as Gruffalo Spotter and the National Trust’s 50 Things."}

{"summary":"Jessica Simpson wore black skinny jeans and stilettos for dinner in Calabasas with fiancé Eric Johnson and daughter Maxwell, three months after welcoming son Ace. The singer says she feels at peace as a mother of two and hinted at a return to music, tweeting, “I need to make music.”"}

{"summary":"Battlefield 1’s open beta ends September 8, with a new patch removing time limits from Sinai Desert Conquest matches so teams must reach 250 points to win. EA also plans server stress tests that may cause downtime ahead of the game’s worldwide October 21 launch."}

{"summary":"When Leann showed her grandfather Ried an ultrasound in September 2015, he cried with joy at learning he would become a great-grandfather—before realizing she was expecting twins. His emotional reaction grew even stronger at the double surprise, and Leann welcomed twin girls in February 2016."}

{"summary":"Harvard’s decades-long Grant Study found that participants with close, stable relationships were happier and healthier, while loneliness was associated with earlier physical and cognitive decline and shorter lives. Director Robert Waldinger emphasizes investing in meaningful connections rather than wealth or career success, though the original study included only white men."}

{"summary":"With Model 3 production planned for July, the article highlights Tesla’s playful hidden features, including rainbow displays and James Bond– and Mars-themed Easter eggs. It also covers Musk’s vehicle expansion plans and the Model S’s safety performance, landmark Motor Trend award, and electric range exceeding 300 miles."}

{"summary":"Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates were the largest recipients of U.S. arms in 2011–2015, as America supplied nearly one-third of global weapons exports. Middle Eastern insecurity and Asian tensions are driving demand, while lifting the U.S. arms embargo allows Vietnam to join the buyers."}

{"summary":"Nine-year-old Molly moved the judges on The Voice Kids Australia with her blind audition of Kasey Chambers’ song about insecurity, while her proud family watched backstage. After praising Molly’s vocal control and confidence, Mel B urged her to join her team with an appeal to “girl power.”"}

{"summary":"BBC golf commentator Peter Alliss was caught on a hot mic commenting on Sergio Garcia’s fiancée Angela Akins’s short skirt and the couple’s sex life after Garcia’s Masters win. The BBC acknowledged the skirt remark was inappropriate, while fans criticized Alliss, who has a history of controversial comments about women."}

{"summary":"Bill Maher urged TV hosts interviewing President-elect Donald Trump to hold him accountable as a politician rather than let him use their shows for favorable publicity. Speaking on “Jimmy Kimmel Live,” Maher also said he would welcome Trump on “Real Time,” noting that his unpredictability made an appearance possible."}

{"summary":"LendLease sold all 391 apartments in the final stage of Sydney’s Darling Square development in four hours, with prices ranging from A$630,000 to A$3.5 million. The sellout signals strong inner-city demand and renewed investor confidence despite concerns about oversupply as tens of thousands of new apartments near completion."}

{"summary":"Lindsay Lohan posted an Instagram photo from a recording studio with her younger sister, singer Ali Lohan, and Duran Duran members Simon Le Bon and Nick Rhodes. Lohan recently appeared in London’s West End production of Speed-the-Plow and reunited with the Mean Girls cast for its 10th anniversary."}

{"summary":"Elizabeth Warren insists she is not running for president, but the article argues that her memoir, “A Fighting Chance,” makes a compelling case for doing so. It highlights her commitment to economic fairness and her history of overcoming reluctance to accept public roles where she could help struggling families."}

{"summary":"The tiny plastic tripod in pizza boxes, called a pizza saver, prevents sagging cardboard lids from touching the pizza and pulling off its cheese. Carmela Vitale designed it in 1983 and received a patent in 1985, but reportedly never manufactured it herself and let the patent lapse in 1993."}

{"summary":"The article predicts flexible schedules and remote work will largely replace the traditional 9-to-5 by 2030, driven by millennials’ priorities, technological advances and office costs. It cites demand for work-family balance and continuing education, alongside a study finding telecommuters at one Chinese firm were 13% more productive."}

{ "summary": "Research by Yonat Zwebner and colleagues suggests that people may come to look like their names. In experiments, volunteers shown a headshot and four or five possible names identified the person’s actual name at a rate significantly higher than chance." }

{"summary":"This subjective ranking of New York’s 10 worst sports seasons places Columbia football’s 44-game losing streak from 1983–88 at No. 1, ahead of the struggling 2014–15 Knicks and the 1962 Mets. Other entries span professional and college teams, highlighting historic defeats, poor management and scandals."}

{"summary":"After a study linked weight regain among former “Biggest Loser” contestants to lasting metabolic changes, host Bob Harper suggested intermittent fasting to help maintain weight loss. Early research suggests fasting can support weight loss, but its long-term effectiveness remains unproven, and it may be unsafe for people with certain medical conditions."}

{"summary":"“Glee” star Alex Newell has joined the ensemble cast of “Geography Club,” a film adaptation of Brent Hartinger’s novel. Newell said the script appealed to him as an opportunity to raise awareness and show audiences experiences reflected in the story."}

{"summary":"Drake’s “Views” has topped the Billboard 200 for nine consecutive weeks, the longest streak since Adele’s “21” in 2012 and an unprecedented streaming-driven run. Nearly 77% of its latest weekly album-equivalent sales came from streaming, highlighting how streaming can sustain a blockbuster album’s chart dominance."}

{"summary":"A 1964 photo shows Alfred Hitchcock wearing a Beatles-style mop-top wig, giving the “Psycho” director an uncanny resemblance to Moe Howard of the Three Stooges. The article highlights the amusing image, shared by Retronaut, while noting that the reason for Hitchcock’s wig is unknown."}

{"summary":"The article compiles unverified claims from former fast-food and concession workers about menu items allegedly made with old ingredients, held too long, or prepared using poorly cleaned equipment. Examples include McDonald’s McCafe drinks, KFC BBQ sandwiches and gas-station slushies; other complaints concern convenience or preparation rather than food safety."}

{"summary":"Galbani’s string and snack cheese packaging features stereotypically male cartoon characters on full-fat products and female characters on reduced-fat versions. The article criticizes this gendered distinction, which an anonymous tipster noticed after their 5-year-old daughter asked for the “girl cheese.”"}

{"summary":"Following news of Irula tribesmen catching invasive pythons in Florida, reporters tracked down Eranna, about 60, a traditional rat catcher in rural Tamil Nadu who is not Irula. He protects crops and catches rats for food, but says his inherited skills may disappear as younger generations pursue city jobs."}

{"summary":"Google created Google Auto LLC in 2011 to legally operate its self-driving car project, documents obtained by The Guardian reveal. The subsidiary is listed as manufacturer of its 23 autonomous Lexus vehicles and licensed as a California automaker, though Google says it still seeks established automakers as manufacturing partners."}

{"summary":"The author defends multilevel marketing businesses promoted on social media, arguing they offer mothers flexible income opportunities and should not be confused with illegal pyramid schemes. Drawing on personal experience, she emphasizes sellers’ hard work and urges readers to support them as a way to help families cover everyday expenses."}

{"summary":"Veteran television reporter Bill Carter is taking a voluntary buyout after more than 25 years at The New York Times, citing financial pressure and generous severance despite his reluctance to leave. The paper is seeking 100 departures, with layoffs possible, while continuing to hire in digital and other growth areas."}

{"summary":"A couple in Gujarat’s Dahod district opted for a tubectomy after having 17 children—16 daughters and one son—following persuasion by villagers and local leaders. Ramsinh, 44, said their family kept growing because he wanted another son, despite the financial strain of raising so many children on farming and labour income."}

{"summary":"Comparing international prices of Starbucks lattes, pizza, chicken wings and Nobu’s black cod offers playful alternatives to the Big Mac index for assessing currencies’ purchasing power. Results vary widely by food, highlighting the strong dollar and London’s expensive dining, while differences in portions, locations and service charges complicate comparisons."}

{"summary":"BBC America released an Orphan Black blooper reel at the show’s Comic-Con panel following its fourth season. One clip shows Tatiana Maslany, who plays multiple characters, accidentally referring to Cosima while performing as Cosima—a mix-up the article suggests must be common for her."}

{"summary":"A dog named Candy nursed three baby genets rescued by South Africa’s Daktari Bush School and Wildlife Orphanage after rock-throwing children drove away their mother. Despite not being pregnant, Candy began producing milk and helped raise them; two returned to the wild, while the third remained at the center."}

{"summary":"California-based Turing Robotic Industries unveiled the Turing Phone Cadenza concept, claiming 12GB RAM, 1TB storage, dual Snapdragon 830 processors and a 60MP camera with 6K recording. The proposed smartphone would run Swordfish OS with deep-learning AI capabilities and was expected to launch the following year."}

{"summary":"Studies show fasting generally makes little clinically significant difference in cholesterol tests, particularly for LDL and HDL, though it may improve triglyceride measurements. U.S. guidelines still prefer fasting, but several European guidelines no longer routinely require it, and experts say nonfasting tests remove a barrier to screening."}

{"summary":"A device spotted in footage of a 1995 Mike Tyson fight is not evidence of a time traveler with a cameraphone; handheld cameras available then could explain it. The article argues that modern assumptions can distort our interpretation of historical footage and technology."}

{"summary":"GrubHub’s analysis of ordering habits at more than 350 college campuses found Syracuse University led late-night ordering, with one-quarter of orders placed between 10 p.m. and 2 a.m. College students were 87 percent more likely than average diners to order late-night meals, while spending less and choosing fewer healthier options."}

{ "summary": "Michigan mother Dayna Mager shared a widely circulated photo her husband took of her asleep in their baby daughter’s crib. She says a missionary’s account of silent babies in a Ugandan orphanage inspired her promise to respond whenever her daughter cries, though the article never reveals the orphanage worker’s explanation." }

{"summary":"This humorous article offers low-effort alternatives to ambitious fitness resolutions, including cutting back on sugary juice, improving posture, stretching, gardening and taking short walks. It also suggests breathing exercises, relaxing baths, limiting stressful social media and drinking warm water, though some health claims are exaggerated or unsupported."}

{"summary":"M&M’s Mega will debut in May 2014 in milk chocolate and peanut varieties, offering three times as much chocolate as regular M&M’s. Developed in response to requests for bigger candies, the new product will cost $1.49 for a small milk chocolate bag and $3.29 for a medium bag."}

{"summary":"A Lovehoney survey of 4,400 customers found sex lasted an average of 19 minutes, including 10 minutes of foreplay, with just over half satisfied with that duration. Around a fifth wanted it to last longer, though the customer-only sample may not represent the wider population."}

{"summary":"Nintendo’s $60 NES Classic Edition, launching in November with 30 built-in games, cannot connect to the internet, use external storage or play cartridges, so its library cannot be expanded. The miniature console is designed as a hassle-free nostalgia purchase for casual players and older fans rather than enthusiasts seeking additional content."}

{"summary":"Mixing milk with Coca-Cola causes the milk to curdle and settle, leaving a clearer liquid—a simple experiment attributed to the soda’s phosphoric acid. The article connects this reaction to concerns about cola consumption and reduced bone density, though the experiment itself does not establish health effects and further research is needed."}

{"summary":"The USDA approved four Chinese poultry processors to export cooked meat from U.S.-raised birds to the United States. Critics cite China’s food-safety problems and warn that imports could eventually include Chinese-raised poultry, while noting that the cooked products require neither origin labeling nor on-site USDA supervision."}

{"summary":"Alison Pill told Conan O’Brien that she accidentally tweeted a topless photo after misunderstanding her new BlackBerry’s touchscreen while replying to someone on Twitter. The “Newsroom” actress, who quickly deleted the image and apologized, called the incident dumb and “hideously embarrassing.”"}

{"summary":"After someone burned an American flag on Ben Schofield’s truck at Wasatch High School in Utah, classmates extinguished the fire and dozens rallied the next day, wearing patriotic colors and flying flags. Police and school officials are investigating, while Schofield returned to school with a replacement flag."}

{"summary":"An Argentine farmer named Jose discovered a large fossil on his property in Carlos Spegazzini, near Buenos Aires, on Christmas Day. Identified as the shell of a glyptodon, an armored relative of the armadillo that could weigh two tons, the fossil is reportedly at least 10,000 years old."}

{"summary":"Labrador retrievers topped the American Kennel Club’s 2016 breed rankings for a record 26th consecutive year, while Rottweilers reached eighth place, their highest ranking in nearly two decades. The rankings reflect newly registered purebred dogs, excluding mixed breeds; other rising breeds include French bulldogs, Siberian huskies and Australian shepherds."}

{"summary":"Michel Bechard was taken into custody Friday after stripping naked in front of a White House security gate. According to a Secret Service spokesman, Bechard assaulted a uniformed officer as officers tried to subdue him."}

{"summary":"Anthony surprised his 17-year-old sister, Anelle, by wearing a cap and gown to her graduation and sitting prominently in the family’s special box seats. A popular graduate from the previous year, he made classmates laugh while Anelle, seated onstage as class secretary, struggled to contain her own laughter."}

{"summary":"A viral fan theory proposes a dark alternate ending to “Friends”: Phoebe, homeless and addicted to meth, imagined herself belonging to the group while watching the five real friends from Central Perk. Posted by Twitter user @strnks, the theory draws on Phoebe’s troubled backstory and has attracted media attention."}

{"summary":"The article recommends placing bay leaves around household corners, especially in kitchens, claiming their scent naturally repels cockroaches. It suggests using dried, crushed leaves for a stronger smell, but provides no evidence that this method prevents or eliminates infestations."}

{"summary":"The FBI arrested a man suspected of spraying a mixture of hand cleaner, water and mouse poison onto food at an Ann Arbor Whole Foods and potentially other Michigan grocery stores. Whole Foods discarded exposed food and sanitized affected areas; no illnesses were reported, and the suspect could face felony charges."}

{"summary":"Madden NFL 2016’s annual Super Bowl simulation predicted the Carolina Panthers would beat the Denver Broncos 24-20, with Cam Newton scoring the winning touchdown and earning MVP honors. The computer-controlled simulation, run once on the game’s hardest setting, had correctly picked nine of the previous 12 Super Bowl winners."}

{"summary":"Mary Lou Bruner lost her bid for a seat on the Texas State Board of Education to chiropractor and local school board president Kevin M. Ellis by a wide margin. Her campaign drew national attention for Facebook posts promoting conspiracy theories and inflammatory claims about President Obama, school shootings and other subjects."}

{"summary":"Researchers have identified Tamu Massif beneath the northwest Pacific Ocean as Earth’s largest volcano, spanning about 400 miles and dwarfing Hawaii’s Mauna Loa. Seismic surveys and lava samples suggest it formed as a single volcano around 144 million years ago, offering new clues about how massive oceanic plateaus develop."}

{"summary":"The August 10 supermoon will be 2014’s largest, becoming full within the same hour it reaches its closest point to Earth and appearing after sunset. It coincides with the Perseid meteor shower, which peaks August 10–13, and is the second of three consecutive monthly supermoons."}

{"summary":"Legendary Simpsons writer John Swartzwelder has joined Twitter, using it to promote his books through excerpts rather than new jokes. The article celebrates the quotes’ dry humor and playfully suggests his unabashed self-promotion might itself be a brilliant joke—or even performance art."}

{"summary":"“Real Housewives” star Adrienne Maloof and Paul Nassif announced they have resolved all outstanding divorce settlement issues and pending litigation. The pair, who filed for divorce in August 2012, said they are committed to co-parenting their three children and prioritizing their well-being, happiness and privacy."}

{"summary":"Former trucker and Fitness Trucking founder Siphiwe Baleka says insufficient sleep can disrupt hunger-regulating hormones and contribute to weight gain, particularly among long-haul drivers. He recommends consistent sleep and wake times, avoiding electronics before bed, and establishing a calming bedtime routine to support better sleep and weight management."}

{"summary":"Shailene Woodley has made “badass” a verbal signature, repeatedly using it in interviews about “Divergent” and beyond. The article collects examples describing her co-star Theo James, stunt double and author Veronica Roth, while emphasizing that her character, Tris, develops toughness rather than possessing it naturally."}

{"summary":"Speedrunner BubblesDelFuego beat Fallout 4 in just over an hour on very easy difficulty, exploiting glitches to teleport, pass through walls and skip major story sections. Developed collaboratively with other runners, the route prioritizes essential quests and efficient movement, with further refinements potentially cutting completion time to 45–55 minutes."}

{"summary":"Cats may purr to express contentment, cope with stress or discomfort, or solicit food, though scientists remain uncertain about its precise meaning. Researchers also suggest that purring’s frequency range of 25–150 hertz could promote muscle and bone repair, potentially making it a form of self-healing."}

{"summary":"While Drake and Ed Sheeran dominated March, the article highlights 10 overlooked pop songs spanning post-punk, house, rap, ballads and retro pop. Picks include The Drums’ “Blood Under My Belt,” Nelly Furtado’s “Phoenix,” Aminé’s “REDMERCEDES,” Steps’ comeback “Scared of the Dark” and TYSM’s intriguingly unconventional “Wraith.”"}

{"summary":"The small cylinder on some laptop charging cables is a ferrite bead, which filters high-frequency electromagnetic interference. It helps prevent the cable from transmitting or picking up unwanted signals that could disrupt nearby electronics, including radios, speakers and Wi-Fi equipment."}

{"summary":"The article links increasing polar bear cannibalism to melting Arctic sea ice, which makes hunting seals harder and drives hungry males to prey on younger bears. It highlights National Geographic footage showing an adult male chasing a mother and cub before killing the cub."}

{"summary":"Tesla’s “Master Plan, Part Deux” outlines plans to expand its electric lineup with a compact SUV, pickup, heavy-duty truck and high-capacity urban transport, with the latter two targeted for 2017 debuts. Elon Musk also aims to improve manufacturing efficiency and production capacity as part of Tesla’s broader sustainability goals."}

{"summary":"A preliminary study of nearly 26,000 men linked Viagra use to a higher risk of melanoma, with current users showing an 84 percent increase. Researchers said the findings warrant further investigation, not prescription changes, and advised users at high risk for melanoma to consult their doctors."}

{"summary":"BuzzFeed rounds up 23 humorous products for people who prefer solitude, including antisocial slogan clothing, accessories, pillows, a bed tent, and home decor. The shopping list includes prices and retailer links, with a disclosure that BuzzFeed may earn a share of sales."}

{"summary":"AMC is promoting “Breaking Bad” for Emmy consideration with suggestive billboards across Los Angeles, despite the show having ended its five-season run last year. After winning Outstanding Drama Series last year, the series is seeking more awards for its final eight episodes, with spin-off “Better Call Saul” still to come."}

{"summary":"Houston is projected to surpass Chicago as America’s third-largest city within a decade, driven by energy-sector jobs, low taxes and migration. Its increasingly diverse, socially progressive population reflects broader changes in Texas, though dependence on oil, traffic congestion and poor air quality pose challenges."}

{"summary":"Air India’s roughly 9,400-mile Pacific route currently ranks as the world’s longest commercial passenger flight by distance, ahead of Emirates and Qantas routes. Planned services could reshuffle the rankings by 2018, including Qantas’s 17-hour Perth–London flight and Singapore Airlines’ proposed 19-hour, 10,252-mile Singapore–New York nonstop."}

{"summary":"The article argues that an Apple acquisition of Tesla, though financially feasible and seemingly complementary, would founder on the clash between Tim Cook’s operational pragmatism and Elon Musk’s independent, risk-taking vision. It contends that Apple’s business priorities would conflict with Musk’s broader environmental ambitions, likely requiring his departure."}

{"summary":"Pokémon chief executive Tsunekazu Ishihara confirmed support for Nintendo’s upcoming NX, saying it would challenge distinctions between home and handheld consoles. His comments bolster unconfirmed rumours of a portable hybrid with detachable controllers; Nintendo planned to unveil the system in 2016 and release it in March 2017."}

{"summary":"“Orange Is the New Black” Season 2 will premiere June 6 on Netflix, the streaming service announced during the closing credits of the “House of Cards” Season 2 finale. Plot details remain scarce, but Laura Prepon will return as Alex for at least four episodes, and Lori Petty joins the cast."}

{"summary":"Golden State tops the NBA power rankings for a fourth straight week after nine consecutive wins, narrowly ahead of Memphis, which leads the league with 15 victories. Western Conference teams occupy the top five spots, while Philadelphia remains firmly last."}

{"summary":"Indian Defence Minister Manohar Parrikar proposed all-women combat units across the armed forces and supported admitting women through the National Defence Academy and Sainik schools. The article praises these proposals as advances in women’s empowerment, while noting Parrikar’s preference for gradual implementation and existing barriers to women’s military service."}

{"summary":"Studies involving hundreds of undergraduates found that women rated men described as skilled storytellers as more attractive long-term partners and higher-status, while men showed no similar preference for women. Researchers suggest storytelling may signal influence or leadership, but whether live storytelling produces the same effect remains untested."}

{"summary":"European guidelines urge employers to support women experiencing menopause, whose symptoms can affect job performance and worsen under stressful or uncomfortable working conditions. Recommended measures include cooler workplaces, flexible schedules, bathroom breaks and manager training, alongside a culture where women feel comfortable requesting accommodations, though research on specific interventions remains limited."}

{"summary":"The article encourages a simple daily morning meditation practice, emphasizing that meditation is accessible to everyone and need not be religious or spiritual. It highlights potential benefits such as better focus and reduced stress, while promoting a one-minute technique learned in China and a free guided meditation download."}

{"summary":"Robert Schwentke will replace Neil Burger as director of “Insurgent,” the sequel to “Divergent,” after a tight production schedule prevented Burger’s return. Schwentke, whose credits include “Red” and “R.I.P.D.,” will direct the Veronica Roth adaptation for a planned March 20, 2015, theatrical release."}

{"summary":"Prince George’s signature shorts reflect a longstanding British aristocratic tradition of dressing young boys in shorts rather than trousers, according to etiquette expert William Hanson. The custom has roots in 16th-century “breeching” and remains a marker of upper-class values upheld by the royal family."}

{"summary":"NPR’s Brian Boyer and his team received a $35,000 Knight Foundation grant to develop Carebot, a tool measuring journalism’s impact through completion rates, reader feedback and sharing rather than clicks alone. They hope rewarding meaningful engagement will encourage stories that make audiences care, reducing incentives for clickbait."}

{"summary":"The article highlights a striking resemblance between Bollywood actor and former supermodel Dino Morea and Scott Foley, who plays Jake in the American TV series Scandal. It notes that others have also noticed the likeness."}

{"summary":"The Sony World Photography Awards has released its shortlist, selected from more than 220,000 entries, with the winner to be announced on 20 April. Featured images span landscapes, wildlife and human experiences worldwide, including Mount Fuji, panda conservation in China, religious ceremonies and portraits exploring racism and poverty."}

{"summary":"The article champions leather jackets as a timeless, versatile staple that men can pair with casual or dressier outfits. It advises choosing a style and budget, weighing leather quality and fit, and trying faux leather before splurging—but firmly discourages leather blazers."}

{"summary":"Pokémon Go developer Niantic plans to introduce advertising through sponsored locations, allowing businesses to pay to appear in the game and attract players to their premises. The article jokingly anticipates user backlash and suggests the model could also draw crowds to concerts or political rallies."}

{"summary":"The article criticizes a school permission slip allowing parents to exempt their children from reciting the Pledge of Allegiance, citing a photo shared on Facebook and a parent’s angry response. Using inflammatory language, it blames Obama and liberals, portrays the exemption as anti-American, and urges readers to support Donald Trump."}

{"summary":"Republican intellectual Avik Roy argues that white nationalism, rooted in the party’s alignment against civil rights in 1964, enabled Donald Trump’s rise and left the GOP incapable of gradual reform. He predicts disruptive change and urges conservatives to build a movement grounded in individual liberty that genuinely appeals to a diverse America."}

{"summary":"Airlines can deny passengers seats because of overbooking, safety constraints, crew transportation needs or rule violations. When flights are too full, federal rules require airlines to seek volunteers first; involuntarily bumped passengers must receive compensation if they reach their destination more than an hour late."}

{"summary":"Website visitors often skim content in an F-shaped pattern, and social shares do not reliably indicate that an article was read. To improve readership, the article recommends testing engagement, supporting mobile readers, putting key information first, and using compelling sentences, clear headings, short paragraphs, lists and explanatory images."}

{"summary":"Sacred Heart University student Nikki Yovino was charged with false reporting and evidence tampering after police said she admitted fabricating rape allegations against two football players to preserve another romantic prospect. The players, who maintained the encounter was consensual, reportedly lost their scholarships and were expelled; Yovino faces up to five years in prison."}

{"summary":"The article reports that Loughborough University researchers found an hour in a 40°C bath could burn around 126 calories—roughly equivalent to a 20–30-minute walk—and help lower blood sugar. It attributes these effects to increased body temperature and heat shock proteins, while cautioning that bathing does not justify unrestricted eating."}

{"summary":"Former congressman Tom Perriello’s surprise entry into Virginia’s 2017 Democratic gubernatorial primary challenges establishment favorite Ralph Northam and echoes divisions exposed by the presidential election. With Republican Ed Gillespie also facing a Trump-aligned challenger, both parties’ June primaries are poised to test their direction and attract national attention."}
